relationships.evidence: Proposed, not enacted. FY2026 Budget Appendix (BUDGET-2026-APP) pp. 332, 338, 339, 346: 'In 2026 HRSA will be reorganized into the Agency [p.339: Administration] for a Healthy America to improve coordination of health resources for Americans.' Repeated for 2027 in the FY2027 Appendix (BUDGET-2027-APP) pp. 434, 439, 449. P.L. 119-75 keeps HRSA.
